resources.string: Private conversations, with a connection you choose.
Development build. Authenticated data connections and optional provider sign-in are available. Calling is not implemented.
Start by saving a service address or choosing your call preferences.
Use a provider you trust. No provider is required by the app.
Save an address for a service you choose. Saving an address does not sign you in or contact its server.
Remove this saved address from this device?
Address saved. Not connected or enrolled.
Use a name of 1–64 characters and an HTTPS origin without a username, password, path, query or fragment.
That service address is already saved.
You can save up to eight service addresses.
Require a YUME connection. Never switch to a direct call automatically.
A direct connection can share your public IP address with your contact and bypass YUME.

Direct calls can reveal your public IP address to your contact and expose a different traffic pattern to your network. End-to-end encryption will still be required. You can return to protected routing at any time.
Preferences for future calls. This build does not encode or transmit audio.
Adjust speech quality to the available connection.
Prefer narrowband speech and fewer packets.
Prefer the lowest usable speech rate. Encryption and your routing choice stay required.
Emergency mode is for weak data connections. Ito does not call emergency services or replace a telephone.
A provider account grants access only to its own service. It cannot change your identity, peer trust or routing preferences.
Preferences could not be read. Existing data has been kept.
The change could not be saved. Try again.
Import your operator’s sealed configuration, select it, then connect. This connection carries Ito data only. It does not create a VPN or a call.
Use the separate code from your operator. Ito encrypts the configuration with Android Keystore and does not retain this code.
The bounded test sends random bytes through the selected authenticated service to an echo destination. Your server must authorize that destination. It never tries a direct connection after a failure.
Optional access to a provider’s infrastructure. Manual configurations remain independent. Providers cannot change your identity, peer trust or routing preferences.
Access suspended. Select a valid configuration explicitly.
Browser enrollment requires an explicit application registration.
Remove this provider before choosing a different server.
Remove local access for %1$s, even when offline. This stops its active connection. Account deletion and remote revocation are separate.
This provider grants access only to its infrastructure. Browser sign-in uses the issuer you accept here.
I accept this provider and issuer.
